skills/better-writing.description: Rewrite, draft, and review prose so it is clear, specific, human, and fits its context. Use when improving emails, reports, documentation, marketing copy, UI text, or posts that sound generic, AI-written, verbose, salesy, or formulaic, and when the user asks to humanise/humanize, de-AI, fix text that sounds like ChatGPT, light edit, copy edit, proofread, or keep my voice. Also use for short UI strings, such as a label, button, or tooltip with a spelling, grammar, or wording problem. Not for condensing a text into a summary or translating it into another language. Covers voice calibration, anti
